Name: Underground Four Corners Space
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#00ff00][size=6][center]﻿[/center][center][b]It acts like a small storage space and a small greenhouse.[/b][/center][/size][/color]
Starting with version 2.7, the position of the entrance can be freely set.
[size=3]This means that we no longer have to worry about compatibility with other mods that replace Farm Map.[/size]
( "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]DebugMode[/url]" is now a required mod to check the map coordinates needed to change the position of the entrance. )
If you want to use it with other mods that add new types of farms, you will need to add compatibility.
Requests to add compatibility with mods that are not currently compatible should be directed to the POSTS page.

[color=#00ffff][size=4]Any other mod that adds new farm types and is currently compatible.[/size][/color]
